task: Finalize in_progress=False on all persisted Codemie Thoughts (including nested children) when a chat turn completes successfully, across both the standard and hedged request-handler paths.

key_reasoning.reason: The fix must land in the shared save_chat_history/_filter_thoughts pipeline that both AssistantRequestHandler._serve_data and hedged_handler's coordinator loop funnel through, and must recurse into nested Thought children — a core shared utility used by two near-duplicate request-handler paths, not a single self-contained change.

AC#6 (genuinely interrupted/failed tool calls must still render as interrupted) and AC#7 (live streaming must not regress) are edge-case acceptance criteria, and the testing landscape confirms no existing test covers them for this path: ThreadedGenerator._process_thought has zero unit tests, and both existing _filter_thoughts tests only exercise in_progress=False or absent, never the stale True case this ticket is about.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped M to L: acceptance criteria enumerate specific edge/error cases (AC#6, AC#7) with no existing defensive test coverage for the stale in_progress merge/finalize scenario.

Component Scope bumped M to L: touches the core shared accumulator/persistence utility (ThreadedGenerator.thoughts -> save_chat_history -> _filter_thoughts) reused by both the standard and hedged handler paths.
